subject: Next steps: Deep dive booking + access details
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Jones <hannah.jones@careflowhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Deep dive booking + access details

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: CareFlow wants predictable low-latency inference for summarization and triage in your clinician-facing workflows, and the top concerns are data separation, audit logs, and predictable per-request pricing under sustained traffic. We think Redwood Dedicated with a canary rollout profile fits the bill for your scale.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive with engineering + security to walk through network requirements, sample throughput numbers, and a short sandbox demo. Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team?

- Tue Jul 25 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed Jul 26 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT

Please also confirm the attendee list (we usually ask for: 1x eng owner, 1x security/compliance, 1x procurement for contract questions). If you prefer another time, happy to adapt.

I’ll include a short agenda and a Zoom link once we lock the slot. Attaching a one-page draft agenda and a first-pass SOW for context.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-deepdive-agenda.pdf, CareFlow_SOW_draft_v1.pdf

From: Hannah Jones <hannah.jones@careflowhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CareFlow Health Procurement <procurement@careflowhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Deep dive booking + access details

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary, that matches our notes. Wed Jul 26 1:00–2:00 PM PT works best for our team. I’ll bring our engineering lead (Sam Park) and loop in our security lead (Priya Rao) — procurement is cc’d for scheduling and initial questions.

One ask: Priya will want basic details about data residency and audit log retention ahead of the call. If you can include a short section in the agenda or a bullet in the invite, that’d speed things up.

See you Wed.
Hannah
Hannah Jones
Head of Product | CareFlow Health
hannah.jones@careflowhealth.com

Locked for Wed Jul 26, 1:00–2:00 PM PT. Calendar invite (ICS) sent to the group and Zoom bridge below. I added a short agenda bullet for data residency & audit logs per Priya’s request.

Zoom meeting: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=ZXpNQk1y
Passcode: CF-7372
Dial-in (US): +1 669 900 9128

Proposed agenda (attached ICS/agenda PDF also in the invite):
- 1:00–1:10 — Introductions & success criteria (Naomi, Hannah)
- 1:10–1:30 — Architecture & network requirements (Vivek + CareFlow eng)
- 1:30–1:45 — Sandbox demo: inference latency & KV caching (Ben)
- 1:45–1:55 — Data residency, audit logs, and retention (Vivek + Priya)
- 1:55–2:00 — Next steps / procurement items (Naomi + procurement)

Attachments included: CareFlow_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, redwood-deepdive-agenda.ics

Logistics notes for the team:
- We’ll prepare a short throughput table tailored to the sample traffic numbers you gave (Hannah) and include expected token costs for the two quantization profiles we discussed.
- Vivek: please bring the network diagram notes and the recommended firewall rules.
- Ben: plan to share the quick demo script and sample prompts that highlight latency at 128 token responses.

If anyone needs an updated calendar time or an earlier dry-run slot for the demo, let me know — otherwise see you Wednesday.

Best,
